## Log URL Opener

Instead of manually navigating to datadog & typing in the search bar, this extension will open a log line on that page for you.

Hover over a log line and you get prompted like this:

![demo](./image.png)

### Setup

From repo root:
```
cd .vscode/extensions/log-url-opener
bun install
bun run compile
```

Then go to your Extensions tab in VS Code and click install.

If you installed before you compiled: uninstall, compile, and install again.
